resources.string: Analyze the screen without leaving another app

When you request analysis or a phone task, GalaxySSI reads the target App UI and uses screenshots only when needed. The selected home-screen Agent may process this content on a configured cloud model or paired computer. Phone operations run only for an explicit execution task. Recording, camera, microphone and location require their Android permissions. Opening another App alone does not start analysis or execution.
Show a draggable button while GalaxySSI is in the background
Enable GalaxySSI accessibility service in system settings
Tap once to capture. Long press for a question, crop, recent result or pause. Android 11 or newer is required. Protected screens cannot be captured.
